output.reason: I find this convincing. Several independent pieces of evidence point the same way: the test rig was out of service, the certificate values repeat, 11% of unused 2026 valves leaked on the bench, and teardowns show deformed seals. It also lines up with the PCN timing and explains why the score improved, and the actions are clear. Two things remain open: it doesn't yet say whether the Corlin seal or the move to Line 3 is the cause, and it gives no figures to back the claim that installer and firmware groups have the same failure rates.
